originStory.title: Why I Built This System
originStory.subtitle: From AI frustration to something that actually works
originStory.story: Like you, I was frustrated. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini. I tried them all. Same result every time: generic output that didn't sound like me. I'd spend more time editing than if I'd written from scratch. Worse, I published pieces that felt... off. Not quite authentic. I didn't know what techniques to learn or how to actually improve. Then I realized: the problem wasn't AI. It was that I hadn't taught AI who I am, how I write, or what my content is about. So I built a system. A complete ecosystem for training AI to understand MY voice, MY style, MY business. After hundreds of pieces of content created with this system, I knew it worked. Now I use it daily, and I'm sharing it with you.
originStory.inspirationPoint: I realized the problem wasn't AI. It was that nobody taught me how to TRAIN it
